name: Harold Morris
source:
A gentleman who serves in the Imperial Army's Reserve Forces. He's from the same generation as [url=/c156180]Duke Brown[/url], and was previously in the same branch of the military.
When he served as a commander, seeing the brutalities of war drove him to an early retirement.

[From Digital Artwork book]
